name: Stratum Executive Formal Dress Uniform
description:
Stratum's formal dress uniform is issued to management-tier employees for client presentations, regulatory appearances, and internal advancement ceremonies. The jacket is structured worsted synth-wool in deep charcoal with a subtle herringbone weave visible only in direct light. Rank insignia is embedded in the left breast in Stratum's standard chromatic thread — color-shifting from silver to gold depending on seniority level, verified by a micro-NFC chip that can be scanned at security checkpoints. The trousers are cut with a full-break hem and include a hidden cable-management channel along the left inner seam for BCI tether routing.

The uniform is not sold — it is issued, registered to the employee's ID, and must be returned upon separation from the company. Employees who leave Stratum under good terms receive a certificate allowing them to purchase the uniform at cost (Φ140). Employees separated for cause have the uniform remotely flagged — the chromatic thread shifts to a flat gray that doesn't respond to light, which is not subtle.
cultural_context: The Stratum dress uniform is recognized throughout Meridian's corporate corridors. Wearing one outside of Stratum employment is technically a terms-of-service violation but not illegal. Gray-market units with the NFC chips removed circulate among people who want the credibility signal without the affiliation. Stratum's security division runs periodic sweeps for flagged or unregistered units.
story_hooks: The character has a Stratum dress uniform with the NFC chip removed — bought gray-market. It gets them past three checkpoints before someone runs a visual ID cross-check and the story gets complicated.

The chromatic thread on a character's legitimately-issued uniform starts shifting to gray before they've received any separation notice. Either the system made an error, or someone inside Stratum has already decided their employment is ending.
A Stratum executive at a formal event is wearing a uniform with gold-level insignia, but the character's BCI flagged an NFC anomaly on the scan. The insignia might be fabricated.
